newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Q4 hotel occupancy highest since 1975.
newsitem.headline: Australian Q4 hotel occupancy highest since 1975.

text.p: Australia's average room occupancy rate for hotels and motels rose to 59.9 percent in the December quarter 1996 from 59.7 percent in the December quarter of 1995, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Thursday.
This was the highest December quarter occupancy rate since the tourist accommodation survey started in 1975, the bureau said.

The occupancy rate rose in December because total Australian demand in terms of room nights occupied increased by 2.8 percent, while capacity available increased by 2.5 percent over the year to the December quarter 1996, it said.

All states and territories recorded increases in room nights occupied, except for Tasmania, while rises in room occupancy rates were only recorded in New South Wales, Victoria, South Australia and the Northern Territory.
Takings from accommodation in hotels and motels across Australia rose by 8.3 percent in the December quarter to A$946 million from the same period the previous year.
